#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build an optimized release binary at ./app.
#
# Every *.c file under src/ is compiled, so a subcommand module may add
# source files inside its own directory without touching this script.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$(dirname "$0")"

CC=${CC:-cc}
CFLAGS=(-std=c17 -O2 -DNDEBUG -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Isrc)

sources=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    sources+=("$f")
done < <(find src -type f -name '*.c' -print0 | sort -z)

"$CC" "${CFLAGS[@]}" -o app "${sources[@]}"

#ifndef CALC_H
#define CALC_H

/*
 * `app calc`: 64-bit integer expression evaluator (see SPEC.md).
 *
 * argv[0] is "calc"; the return value is the process exit status.
 */
int calc_main(int argc, char **argv);

#endif /* CALC_H */

#ifndef LRU_H
#define LRU_H

/*
 * `app lru`: LRU cache simulator (see SPEC.md).
 *
 * argv[0] is "lru"; the return value is the process exit status.
 */
int lru_main(int argc, char **argv);

#endif /* LRU_H */

#ifndef WORDFREQ_H
#define WORDFREQ_H

/*
 * `app wordfreq`: word frequencies (see SPEC.md).
 *
 * argv[0] is "wordfreq"; the return value is the process exit status.
 */
int wordfreq_main(int argc, char **argv);

#endif /* WORDFREQ_H */
